result.summary: The home screen is mostly well laid out. The main visual defect is a loading spinner stuck on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, which suggests the image or content has not finished loading. A few smaller styling and accessibility concerns also show up.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner sits in a white circle in the middle of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image. The illustration is already rendered behind it, so the card looks stuck in a loading state or has a leftover overlay. It covers the main subject of the image.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once the image has loaded. If it really is still loading, show a proper skeleton or placeholder instead of a spinner over partly rendered content. Add a timeout and error fallback.

issues.description: The time pills (e.g. '15–25 min') on the 'Fastest near you' cards overlap the plate image and hang over the bottom-left edge of the image. On the first card the pill covers part of the plate and looks awkwardly placed.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the pills at a consistent inset inside the image bounds and keep them clear of the main subject of the image.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, the '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' line, the search placeholder) is light gray on white or light gray backgrounds and has borderline contrast. The heart icon on the dark image also has a low-contrast translucent background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1). Give the favorite button a more opaque background.

issues.description: The discount badge '−20%' and the heart button on the pizza card use different offsets and treatments than the ramen card. The '€0 delivery' badge is green text on white while the '−20%' badge is styled differently, so the badges look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the badge style, position, and heart button styling across cards.
